verdict.rationale: Yubico's PIV docs show RSA/ECC sign and encrypt operations with a private key held on the YubiKey through PKCS#11. PIV attestation proves keys were generated on the device and not imported, a community user confirms it works as a PIV smartcard, and ykman manages the PIV slots. That covers the core of certificate-based smart card use. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the workstation/Windows smart card sign-in, VPN and code-signing workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of those scenarios.
